hints.title: How to read the encoder position
hints.content: Use `int position = driveMotor.getCurrentPosition();` to get the current encoder tick count. The motor returns 537 in this simulation.

hints.title: How to display it on telemetry
hints.content: Use `telemetry.addData("Position", position);` followed by `telemetry.update();` to show the value on the Driver Station.

hints.title: Why 537?
hints.content: 537 ticks is approximately one full revolution of a goBILDA 312 RPM motor (which has 537.7 ticks per revolution). With a 96mm wheel, that is about 30 cm of travel.
